channel.title: 个人数学雷达
channel.description: 数学、形式化证明与 AI for Math；来源原文摘录及中文译文

item.title: Please STOP writing papers! （还有另一种方法）
item.description: 提交给 arXiv 数学部分的论文数量呈爆炸式增长，最近促使 arXiv 对每位作者的提交量施加上限。作为一名编辑，我还看到数学期刊的投稿量大幅增加。这是非常令人担忧的：现有的出版系统无法吸收如此大量的论文。 […]

item.title: What Does AI Do for Olympiad Students?
item.description: “有充分的证据表明，人工智能已经解决了 IMO，能够输出在大多数或所有问题上得分 7 的 LaTeX，几乎保证了在那里和类似比赛中的最高荣誉。尽管如此，我在社区中看到的是，人工智能并没有对比赛或比赛准备产生有意义的影响。[...]”

item.title: Updates from the AHM: guidelines on doctoral advising
item.description: “We are happy to announce that the Teaching Working Group of the Association for Human Mathematics wrote a set of recommendations on doctoral advising aimed at departments, advisors, and students. The document contains five guidelines centered on prioritizing human-authored writing, avoiding overreliance on AI, confronting the ethical concerns of AI use, and improving the wellbeing of students, as well as concrete proposals on how to implement them. […]”

item.title: 基准等价关系比较
item.description:
We determine all Borel-reducibility comparisons within the family of benchmark equivalence relations in Gao's monograph, enlarged by the universal treeable relation $E_{\infty T}$ and its countable power $E_{\infty T}^\omega$. We prove $E_\infty^\omega\leq_B c_0$, $E_\infty
leq_B\ell_p$ for $2 <\infty$, $\ell_p
leq_B{\equiv_m}$ for $2 <\infty$, $c_0
leq_B{\equiv_m}$, $c_0
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$, and $\equiv_m
leq_B\ell_\infty^+$. Together with the classical result, these give $\ell_p\leq_B{\equiv_m}$ exactly when $p\leq2$. The same methods show that $E_{\infty T}$ is incomparable with every $\ell_p$, $1\leq p<\infty$. The comparisons answer questions recorded in Gao's monograph and Kanovei's monograph. We also prove that unitary equivalence of all bounded linear operators is not Borel reducible to $\equiv_m$, answering a question of Ding and Gao. Equivalently, unitary equivalence of arbitrary representations of $F_\infty$ is strictly more complicated than that of arbitrary representations of $\mathbb Z$, answering a question of Thomas.

item.title: A law of the iterated logarithm for random multiplicative functions on integers with a large prime factor
item.description: 令 $f$ 为无平方整数上支持的 Rademacher 随机乘法函数。我们研究了限制和 $M^{>}(x)=\sum_{n\le x;~ P(n)>x^{1/2}}f(n)$ 的几乎确定的波动，其中 $P(n)$ 是 $n$ 的最大素因子。由于 $Q(x)$ 是 $M^{>}(x)$ 的条件方差，给定质数处的 $f$ 值不超过 $x^{1/2}$，我们几乎可以肯定地证明，$M^{>}(x)(2Q(x)\log\log Q(x))^{-1/2}$ 作为 $x\to\infty$ 的上限和下限分别为 $1$ 和 $-1$。此外，表明归一化和的几乎确定的簇集是$[-1,1]$。

item.title: 积分布劳尔--费马差点的马宁阻碍
item.description: 我们研究 $x^4+y^4-w^2=m^2$ 给出的仿射曲面的积分哈斯原理，其中 $m>1$ 是奇数且无平方。我们给出了一个判断是否存在积分布劳尔-马宁障碍的标准，该标准仅取决于 $m$ 模 $8$ 的质因数的简单同余条件。我们用它来表明，对于 $100\%$ 的此类曲面，积分点的哈斯原理不存在积分布劳尔-马宁障碍。

item.title: A Local Fourier-Transform Proof of Offen's Spherical Transfer Theorem
item.description: 令 $E/F$ 为特征零和奇残差特征的非阿基米德局部场的未分支二次扩展。 Offen 证明，在非简并 Hermitian 矩阵的全球面空间上，Hironaka 和 Satake 变换的等式意味着 Jacquet-Ye 匹配。我们给出这个定理的纯局部证明。该论证结合了 Jacquet 匹配与傅立叶变换的兼容性、Godement-Jacquet 函数方程以及 Hironaka 的 Hermitian zeta 积分标量函数方程。局部证明从单位情况中恢复了 Jacquet 的球形-Hecke 基本引理。

item.title: Erd\H{o}s--Straus Conjecture: Modular Inversion in Mordell Classes
item.description: We examine modular inversion of strict Grid certificates in a ceiling continued-fraction construction for the Erd\H{o}s--Straus equation. The six Mordell classes modulo $840$ form four inversion orbits. Prime-input pattern frequencies in the pairs $121 \leftrightarrow361 $ and $289 \leftrightarrow 529$ have equal asymptotic limits for every fixed cutoff.

item.title: 重新审视素数簇
item.description: We revisit the generalized Rayleigh quotient optimization problem related to the Maynard-Tao sieve with the goal of finding a more efficient function basis. We demonstrate that a family based on products of reciprocals, previously used in asymptotic estimates for $H_m = \liminf_{n \to \infty}(p_{n+m}-p_n)$, provides results that are close to the theoretical limits of the sieve across many regimes. In particular, we establish $H_2 \leq 31 \, 140$, $H_3 \leq 2 \, 560 \, 022$, $H_4 \leq 193 \, 672 \, 056$, and $H_5 \leq 13 \, 659 \, 045 \, 840$. We also show that, as $k \to \infty$, the related variational quantity $M_k$, introduced by Maynard, satisfies the lower bound $M_k \geq \log k - 0.273572 + o(1)$.

item.title: 函数场 zeta 函数的谱理论
item.description: 我们研究由与有限域上的曲线 zeta 函数相关的 Weil 二次形式构造的希尔伯特空间，以及这些空间上微分算子的自伴随扩展。对于这些扩展的杰出族，我们证明特征值收敛到 zeta 函数零点的纵坐标，并且相应的整个谱函数在归一化后局部均匀地收敛到由这些零点确定的无限乘积。当区间参数接近有限端点时，就会出现这些限制，而不是像黎曼 zeta 函数设置中那样无穷大。我们还通过 Rosati 迹配对实现了全局希尔伯特空间，并证明 $\log q$ 的平移统一等价于归一化 Frobenius 的乘法。这为与黎曼 zeta 函数相关的类似解析结构提供了一个几何模型。

item.title: 穿刺射影线上的韦尔算子和安德森余数生成函数
item.description: 令 $A_\rho$ 为 $\Fq$ 上的投影线的坐标环，并删除了 $N$ 度的闭点。我们给出了Riemann-Roch空间基上的高Weil算子的有限公式，恢复了$N=1$时Hu--Ou--Yang的公式。我们用残差卡西米尔张量的代表来识别这些算子，并获得相对于所选行列式实现的 Weil 配对的行列式公式。对于归一化的一阶 Drinfeld 模块，我们计算其安德森生成函数对任何非常数 $p\in A_\rho$ 取模的余数。该公式包括多个零和无穷远普通点处的零。它的最后一个系数是指数除法值的非零标量倍数。当 $(p)$ 是有限主素数时，$p$ 的一个零处的相关特殊函数的值在邻接该零后生成挠场。我们给出了一个显式的 $q$-线性公式，从该值恢复扭转发生器。我们还专门研究了 Gazda--Maurischat 的评估定理，并计算不同的主理想 $(\partial_xp)$。

item.title: (1, 4) 型非齐次二次形式的正值：常数 \Gamma_{1,4} = 8
item.description: Let Q be a real indefinite quadratic form of type (1, 4) with determinant D \neq 0. We prove that for every c \in \mathbb{R}^5 there exists x \in \mathbb{Z}^5 such that 0 < Q(x + c) \le (8|D|)^{1/5}, and that the constant 8 is optimal. This establishes a conjecture of Bambah, Dumir and Hans-Gill and, together with earlier work, completes the determination of the sharp constants \Gamma_{r,s} for positive inhomogeneous values of nondegenerate indefinite quadratic forms. The proof combines classical reduction and gap theorems with uniform bounds for circular gaps of quadratic residues. A central step identifies the exceptional parameters in certain resonant reduced families: an explicit ladder of integer witnesses resolves their punctured neighbourhoods, leaving only three rational parameter points, subject to stated coefficient conditions. These are treated by retaining the coupling in a preceding, less reduced form. The remaining covering statements are verified by finite certificates in exact rational arithmetic.

item.title: 异质周期花束上根源游击边缘地理的优胜者分类
item.description: We consider an undirected edge-traversal game on a finite bouquet of simple cycles. Each of two players controls a token, both tokens begin at the common root, and the players alternate traversing edges that have not been used by either token. A player with no legal move loses. We prove that the first player wins precisely when the number of cycles of odd edge-length is odd, without assuming equal cycle lengths. The proof uses a simultaneous induction on root and defense configurations, with an exact analysis of the forced race between two opened cycles. We also explain how the classification corresponds to a completed Lean 4 formalization of the underlying game on finite edge sets.

item.title: Sharp bounds, stability, and arithmetic fluctuations for induced pentagons
item.description: 我们证明每个具有 $m>0$ 边的图最多包含 $\frac{3}{2\sqrt{2}}(\frac{m}{5})^{5/2}$ 诱导五边形。等式恰好适用于 Clebsch 图的平衡放大以及孤立的顶点。边界和等式分类扩展到任意非负顶点权重和所有图元，包括分数图元。此外，归一化比率中 $\varepsilon$ 的缺陷可以通过对原始顶点集进行 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon}m)$ 边缘编辑来修复，从而产生精确平衡的 Clebsch 放大和隔离。指数 $1/2$ 是最佳的。我们进一步将邻接错误的线性成本与类不平衡的二次成本分开。这产生了有限边缘赤字及其显式二阶项的算术描述，以及统一的节能余数。对于每个固定整数$j$，$m=40k^2+j$处的精确极值计数最终是$k$中的整数系数多项式，可通过有限枚举计算；我们不量化其有效性阈值。该证明结合了全局变分条件、活性密度界和精确有理证明

item.title: 四位并不孤单的跑步者
item.description: 对于正整数 $v_1,\dots,v_n$ 令 $\mathrm{ML}(v_1,\dots,v_n)=\max_t\min_i\|v_it\|$，其中 $\|x\|$ 是到最近整数的距离。 Kravitz 询问哪些值低于 $1/n$。对于 $n=4$，Jain 和 Kravitz 表明低于 $1/4$ 的值是 $m/(4m+2)$、$m\ge2$，最多有有限多个未确定的异常。我们彻底解决了四人案件。原始四元组的 $\mathrm{ML}<1/4$ 当且仅当其在阶上为 $\{1,2,3,4k\}$ 或 $\{x,y,x+y,x+2y\}$ 且 $\gcd(x,y)=1$ 且 $y\not\equiv x,2x\pmod 4$ 或 $\{1,3,4,14\}$ 时。 $1/4$ 以下的值恰好是 $m/(4m+2)$，其中 $m\ge2$、$m\ne3$，因此 $3/14$ 是唯一的例外，Fan 和 Sun 的猜想 4.1 成立。密度引理将两个关键 subtorus 上的四元组的长度限制为 $512$，并且对 800,816,099 个四元组的精确搜索完成了证明。同样的方法表明，孤独度低于 $2/5$ 的 $(\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z})^4$ 的二维 subtori 恰好采用该范围内的三轮值，其中 $1/3$ 和 $2/5$ 之间是分数 $p/q$ 与 $1\le 2q-5p\le 4$。因此四轮规格的累积点

item.title: Asymptotic stability of clique-saturating edges near Tur\'an thresholds
item.description: Let $f_{p+1}(n,m)$ denote the minimum number of $K_{p+1}$-saturating edges in an $n$-vertex $K_{p+1}$-free graph with $m$ edges. In this paper, we investigate the stability of this parameter near the Tur\'an thresholds, with particular emphasis on the role of the minimum degree. We introduce the refined parameter $f_{p+1,p}(n,m,\delta)$. It is defined for $K_{p+1}$-free graphs on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges, minimum degree $\delta$, and containing at least a copy of $K_p$. For every fixed integer $p\ge3$, we establish a stability result when the number of edges is $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_p)+o(n^2)$, showing that \[ f_{p+1,p} (n,m,\delta)=\left(\frac{(p-2)^2}{2(p-1)^3}+o(1)\right)n^2, \ \text{for }\ m=\mathrm{ex}(n,K_p)+o(n^2), \ \delta\geq \left(\frac{p-2}{p-1}+o(1)\right)n. \] We further obtain a stability theorem in the regime where the number of edges is quadratically smaller than $\operatorname{ex}(n,K_{p+1})$. More precisely, for $0 \leq c< \frac{1}{2p(3p-1)}$, \[ f_{p+1,p} (n,m,\delta)=\left(\frac{1}{2p}+o(1)\right)n^2, \ \text{for }\ m=\operatorname{ex}(n,K_{p+1})-(c+o(1))n^2, \ \delta\geq \left(\frac{p-1}{p}-2c+o(1)\right)n. \]

item.title: Hibi--Li(2016)猜想彻底解决
item.description: Hibi and Li conjectured that the order polytope $\mathcal{O}(P)$ of a finite poset $P$ has at most as many faces of each dimension as its chain polytope $\mathcal{C}(P)$, and that equality in some dimension $k$ with $1\leq k\leq|P|-1$ forces the two polytopes to be unimodularly equivalent. Fourier proved the inequality in a 2026 preprint. Let $X$ be the five-element poset in which an element lies above two incomparable elements and below two other incomparable elements. Building on Fourier's proof, we show that if an $n$-element poset contains $X$ as an induced subposet, then, for every $k$ with $2\leq k\leq n-1$, its chain polytope has at least $\binom{n-3}{k-2}$ more $k$-dimensional faces than its order polytope, and that for every $n\geq5$ some $n$-element poset containing $X$ attains all these bounds at once. Since Hibi and Li showed that $\mathcal{O}(P)$ and $\mathcal{C}(P)$ are unimodularly equivalent exactly when $P$ does not contain $X$, this proves the equality statement for these $k$. item.title: 有限阿贝尔群中的反集中和格雷厄姆重排问题
item.description: Let $S$ be a subset of $n$ elements of a group $G$. An ordering $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ of its elements is valid if the partial sums $x_1,x_1+x_2,\ldots,x_1+\cdots+x_n$ are pairwise distinct. This notion has a long history in combinatorial group theory, dated back to Gordon's works in early 1960. Alspach-Liversidge conjecture asserts that any subset of the nonzero elements of a finite abelian group $G$ has a valid ordering. This generalizes Graham's conjecture, which considers the case when the group $G$ is $\mathbb{F}_p$, the cyclic group of prime order. Graham's conjecture has been solved recently, as a combination of results by Kravitz, Bedert and Kravitz, M\"uyesser and Pokrovskiy, Bedert, Buci\'c, Kravitz, Montgomery, and M\"uyesser, and Pham and Sauermann. Beside this, the only other case where Alspach-Liversidge conjecture has been confirmed is $G=\mathbb{F}_2^k$, thanks to a recent result by Bedert, Buci\'c, Kravitz, Montgomery, and M\"uyesser. We prove the Alspach-Liversidge conjecture in its full generality. Our proof combines ideas from many previous papers. In particular, we will use the probabilistic approach and the absorption

item.title: Cranston--Li--Su--Wang--Xu (2026)猜想成立
item.description: Let $A$ be a finite abelian group. A nowhere-zero $A$-flow of a graph gives every edge a direction and a non-zero value in $A$, so that at every vertex the sum of the values on the entering edges equals the sum on the leaving edges. Such a flow can be changed along a cycle: going around the cycle, add a fixed non-zero element of $A$ to the value of every edge that points forward and subtract it from the value of every edge that points backward. The Cranston--Li--Su--Wang--Xu (2026) conjecture states that if $A$ has at least four elements, then in every graph in which all degrees are even, any two nowhere-zero $A$-flows are joined by a chain of such changes through nowhere-zero $A$-flows. It also states that, for every integer $k\ge 4$, the same holds for integer flows whose values are between $1$ and $k-1$ in absolute value, where each change adds a non-zero integer. We prove this conjecture. item.title: 泡沫同质性
item.description: 使用一种统一的方法来识别每个统计-动作对的伸缩函数，我们证明了 La Croix 和 Roby 以及 Sheridan-Rossi 的猜想，即各种排列统计量（例如固定点的数量）在 Foatic 动作下是同源的：Foata 双射和单行符号的二面体对称性的组合。这些结果的基础是一系列与 Foata 双射排列统计相关的双射恒等式；其中之一——反向补码下从右到左最小值数量的意外不变性，由显式双射证明——可能具有独立的意义。伸缩函数也被一些 Foatic 动作所共享，这意味着混合某些动作仍然会在封闭行走中产生恒定的平均值。

item.title: 泰特和阿廷--泰特动机张量-三角形几何
item.description: 我们在特征不同于 $p$ 的任何场上使用 $\mathbb{F}_p$ 系数计算几何 Tate 和 Artin--Tate 动机的巴尔默谱。对于泰特动机，我们发现二级比较图是基场动机上同调的齐次谱的同胚。对于 Artin--Tate 动机，我们将谱描述为 Balmer--Gallauer 计算出的 Artin 动机谱与刺穿的 Tate 谱的粘合。我们确定这些部分和最终拓扑之间的所有专业化。在有理泰特动机谱是单例的假设下，我们还计算了基域指数特征求逆后的积分泰特谱。根据我们的结果，我们将刺穿的泰特谱识别为几何 Voevodsky 动机类别谱的开放子空间，并得出有关后者的一些结论。最后，我们包括一个附录，我们在张量三角形几何的背景下定义广义周期性，并探索其在动机设置中的应用。

item.title: Integral Hodge structures and atoms of fourfolds
item.description: 继 OpenAI 最近对哈塞特除数中非常一般的三次四重的无理性进行研究之后，我们证明了 Iritani 的爆炸公式与积分 Hodge 结构的经典爆炸分解的某些兼容性。因此，我们用 Katzarkov-Kontsevich-Pantev-Yu 提出的原子理论来表达 OpenAI 的双有理不变量。我们还证明，对于每个光滑复有理三次四重，原上同调作为积分 Hodge 结构与 K3 曲面的扭曲中上同调是等距的，并且我们证明了非常一般的 Verra 四重的非理性。

item.title: 截断的格拉斯曼函数：多胞形、表示和柯西公式
item.description: 本文的目标是开发代数和组合技术来研究截断格拉斯曼量的几何性质，截断格拉斯曼量是通过经典格拉斯曼量在其 Pl\"ucker 嵌入中的某些投影获得的一类代数簇。我们引入了一类一般线性李代数的最大抛物线子代数的循环表示，它们被证明可以作为截断的坐标环的齐次分量的对偶。我们证明了这些表示的特征是通过截断的柯西公式计算的，并与完全共线的坐标环建立了联系。我们还根据某些广义链多胞形构造了这些表示的单项式基，并使用 RSK 对应关系与柯西型公式和 Gelfand-Tsetlin 模式建立了联系。

item.title: 紧凑型 K\"ahler 三倍零小平维的均匀化
item.description: Given two smooth compact K\"ahler threefolds $X$ and $Y$ whose universal covers are biholomorphic, we show that $\kappa(X) = 0$ if and only if $\kappa(Y) =0$.

item.title: $d\leq 15$ 的 $(1,d)$ 阿贝尔曲面上的超椭圆曲线
item.description: Bryan、Oberdieck、Pandharipande 和 Yin 预测了横截条件下一般阿贝尔曲面上的超椭圆曲线的数量。其中一些数字已经得到确认。在本文中，我们在 $(1,d)$ 极化阿贝尔曲面上构造 $d\leq 15$ 的奇异超椭圆曲线，确认了一些预测数字，即 $(1,2k)$ 和 $(1,2k+1)$ 极化曲面上的（几何）亏格 $g=d$ 和几何亏格 $k+3$。此外，我们发现一般$(1,8)$偏振面上的所有属7超椭圆曲线都是局部嵌入到$(1,4)$偏振面上的曲线的双重覆盖。更有趣的是，有一条独特的9型超椭圆曲线（直到平移）局部嵌入到一般的$(1,12)$偏振表面中，并且它是局部嵌入到$(1,3)$偏振表面中的曲线的克莱因覆盖。

item.title: 次极大量子指数有理曲线
item.description: On a complex toric surface, oriented real rational curves tangent to the toric boundary at real points are distinguished by their value of quantum index. Using variants of usual Welschinger multiplicities, G. Mikhalkin defined enumerative invariants $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ that are provided by a signed count of oriented real rational curves with given quantum index $\kappa$ and fixed tangency points on the boundary of the positive quadrant (the tangency orders being encoded by $\tilde{\Delta}$). We prove that, for most toric surfaces and tangency orders, the invariant $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$ is zero in the case of the highest nonmaximal value of $\kappa$. This is done by enumerating tropical curves with Block--G\"ottsche multiplicities. Additionally, we prove that, in many situations, the lower bound, given by the absolute value $|W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}|$ of $W_{\tilde{\Delta}}^{\kappa}$, for the number of oriented real rational curves is not sharp close to the tropical limit in the case of the highest nonmaximal value of $\kappa$.

item.title: An atomic approach to Shokurov's conic-bundle conjecture
item.description: In this paper, we apply a weaker version of Hodge atoms to show that a standard conic bundle over a smooth complex projective rational surface $S$ is irrational if $|2K_S+\Delta|\ne\emptyset$, where $\Delta$ is the discriminant divisor. This proves Shokurov's conjecture on rationality of conic bundle threefolds. As an application, we deduce precisely which nodal quartic double solids are rational.

item.title: Odd-Degree Rigidity and a Numerical Characterization of Complete Flag Varieties
item.description: 令 $F=G/B$ 为连通半单复线性代数群的完全标志簇。我们证明，如果光滑 Fano 簇 $X$ 与 $F$ 具有相同的维数和皮卡德数，则奇拓扑度的连续映射 $X\to F$ 的存在意味着 $X$ 与 $F$ 同构。特别是，等价于 $F$ 的光滑 Fano 簇同伦与 $F$ 同构。代数输入是完全标志的数值表征：正维平滑 Fano 簇 $X$ 是完全标志簇当且仅当其伪索引 $\iota_X$ 至少为 2 并且 ${\rm ker}({\rm Sym}^2N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}\to N^2(X)_{\mathbb R})$ 包含正定二次形式。伪索引条件可以等效地替换为 ${\rm Pic}(X)$ 中 $-K_X$ 能被 2 整除。关键的观察结果是，单个确定的二次关系排除了任何基本收缩的每个纤维中的表面；标准收缩定理然后产生平滑的${\mathbb P}^1$-纤维并且应用完整标志的表征。对于奇次定理，庞加莱对偶性和模二吴级论证表明

item.title: 触发数据包流分析：一般触发延迟下系统时间的随机界限
item.description: Many emerging communication systems increasingly involve devices that transmit packets in multiple causally dependent stages as part of an internal workflow, rather than waiting for receiver feedback. To analyze such systems, we recently introduced the $\mathrm{M^T/G/1}$ queue, in which primary customers arrive according to an exogenous Poisson process, and each triggers a secondary customer to join the queue after an independent random delay, called the \textit{triggering delay}. Our prior heuristic approximations assume identical exponential service times, and our matrix-analytic framework assumes exponential triggering delays. However, no exact analysis is available when both distributions are general. In this paper, we derive stochastic bounds, in the usual stochastic order, on the system-time distribution of each customer class under general triggering-delay and service-time distributions. The service times within each primary--secondary pair may be generally dependent. Using sample-path coupling and level-crossing arguments, we show that the stationary workload is stochastically sandwiched between those of two classical queues:

item.title: 通过泊松嵌入进行计数过程过滤的 Martingale 表示
item.description: We revisit martingale representation for counting processes using the Poisson embedding, deriving the representation in their natural filtration from that of the underlying Poisson random measure. Our approach combines Poisson Malliavin calculus with the Clark-Ocone and Mecke formulas. We first characterize measurability with respect to the counting-process filtration through the structure of the Malliavin derivative. We show that any random variable measurable in the counting-process filtration is invariant with respect to the auxiliary mark on the acceptance region obtained from the Poisson embedding method and vanishes on the rejection region. We then prove that every square-integrable martingale in this smaller filtration consequently admits a unique stochastic integral representation with respect to the compensated counting process: the integrand is explicitly characterized as the conditional expectation of the Malliavin derivative, which identifies as the conditional effect of an additional accepted event on the terminal functional. Additionally, we define the mirroring counting process which counts the rejected events in the Po

item.title: Strong solvability and its failure for critical SDEs
item.description: We revisit the construction of strong solutions to singular SDEs by compactness on Wiener space. For spatially varying diffusion coefficients, assuming sufficiently small form bounds on the drift and diffusion gradient, we use basic energy estimates and an extended compactness criterion for Wiener functionals to construct an approximation-independent stochastic flow of homeomorphisms. Both forward and inverse maps have local Sobolev moment bounds, and the resulting strong solutions are pathwise unique in a class of solutions satisfying a Krylov estimate. We also show that the endpoint critical condition $b\in L^\infty_tL^d_x$, together with $\mathrm{div } b=0$ does not guarantee the existence of a strong solution. For every $d\geq2$, we construct a SDE with a divergence-free drift in this class and an additive Brownian noise, started from the origin, has a weak solution unique in law, but no strong solution. The proof uses logarithmic rescaling to characterize strong solvability by whether the sample measures of an associated stationary diffusion are Dirac masses. Positivity of the top Lyapunov exponent, combined with random SRB theor

item.title: Efficient Importance Sampling of Brownian Motion Avoiding Poissonian Obstacles for Long Time
item.description: We design and analyze an efficient importance sampling estimator of the probability that, over a long time horizon, a Brownian particle avoids obstacles of a fixed radius placed according to an independent Poisson random field. Donsker and Varadhan identify the exponential decay rate of this probability as the optimal balance between the volume cleared of obstacles and the spectral cost of confinement, and the confinement results of Sznitman and Povel show that the particle survives by localizing its path in a ball of (roughly) deterministic radius but with a random center. This strategy makes direct Monte Carlo exponentially ineffective over long horizons, and makes a practical yet asymptotically optimal sampler non-trivial to design, since the sampler must track the random region swept out by the path. For every fixed dimension \(d\ge2\) and every fixed obstacle radius, we construct a sequential importance sampler that is unbiased and asymptotically optimal. The full algorithm has finite expected total work at every fixed horizon, and both its expected work and the coefficient of variation grow at most subexponentially with the time

item.title: 快速挖掘区块链的模型
item.description: We study a Markovian model for a blockchain mining process. In the limit where there is an infinite number of miners, the model satisfies a functional law of large numbers due to Barbour and Luczac (2008), leading to an infinite set of coupled ODEs characterising the blockchain heights. We show that the sequence of solutions to this system converges uniformly, to a limiting profile in an appropriate comoving frame. Utilising asymptotic arguments inspired by Brunet and Derrida (1997), we derive an explicit expression for the position of the travelling front, which exhibits a leading order logarithmic Bramson correction in time. For a finite number of miners, we further derive a correction to the travelling speed which is logarithmic in the number of miners. Finally, by application of a computation due to Ablowitz and Zeppetella (1979), we identify that, for a specific choice of the travelling speed, the Painlev\'e integrable, travelling wave solution of the Fisher-KPP equation with drift accurately matches our limiting profile. Our results are supported by numerical simulations.

item.title: 有限群随机凯莱图的截止
item.description: 我们研究有限群凯莱图上的随机游走，该群的生成器是独立且均匀随机选择的。我们证明，对于每个有限群，当生成器的数量与该群的阶数的对数相比较大但与它的每个正幂相比较小时，游走就会以高概率表现出截止。截止时间是步行的预期熵接近最大值的时间，通常取决于群体的结构。这解决了奥尔德斯和迪亚科尼斯的猜想。

item.title: 循环催化反应的强适定性--具有突变和迁移的扩散SPDE
item.description: 我们研究具有突变和迁移的循环催化随机反应扩散系统。这些方程具有平方根催化系数和空间有色噪声。在要求循环向内漂移主导相应噪声协方差的条件下，我们为非负初始状态建立了全局强适定性。我们的方法结合了保正近似、统一能量估计和控制状态占据接近于零的凹功率熵。这些边界估计使我们能够导出两个同步弱变分解的海林格稳定性不等式，从而直接在该解类中产生路径唯一性。然后，我们使用近似解及其驱动噪声的联合紧性，以及鞅识别和 Gyongy-Krylov 准则，在规定的维纳空间上构建概率强的解。

item.title: 二次形式浓度下样本协方差矩阵的 Tracy Widom 定律
item.description: 我们研究由 i.i.d.、居中、各向同性随机向量 $q_1, \dots, q_N \in \mathbb{R}^M$ 形成的样本协方差矩阵，其坐标允许相互依赖。我们假设随机向量满足其二次形式 $q_i^T A q_i$ 的浓度界限。在此假设下，我们建立边缘普适性，并在适当的居中和缩放后获得样本协方差矩阵最大特征值的Tracy--Widom定律。特别是，我们的结果消除了对数凹系综现有边缘普遍性结果中的无条件假设~\cite{BX}，解决了最初激发我们工作的问题。浓度假设还允许我们将结果扩展到对数凹类之外。

item.title: 对抗性朗斯基主义者：Kung-Traub 猜想的证明
item.description: 我们证明了 Kung--Traub 猜想：一种没有记忆的确定性平稳求根方法，每次迭代最多使用 $n$ 实标量函数或导数评估，在每个具有简单零的实解析函数上不能具有大于 $2^{n-1}$ 的局部阶数。对于 $n\geq2$，通过 Kung 和 Traub 的方法获得界限。在每个足够接近的起点处都需要局部估计，其常数可能取决于函数。评估点和导数阶数可以自适应地选择，并且选择它们和处理数据的规则不受限制。该证明使用多项式 Wronskians 的本地化属性来获得每个固定尺度的下界。然后，对角线构造给出一个完整的函数，其导数在实线上和下界为界，对于该函数，每个较大的订单都会失败。当在规定的组中进行评估时，我们还获得了更清晰的界限，并证明了复杂标量评估的相应结果。这篇论文的结果也在Lean中得到了形式化的验证。

item.title: 输运方程的节点守界有限元法
item.description: 运输问题的数值近似，即使稳定了，也常常违反精确解所遵循的界限。根据要解决的问题，这可能会产生非物理结果，例如负密度或高于单位的浓度。存在各种保界数值方法，但它们通常要么是条件稳定的，要么只是一阶精确的。在这种情况下，目前的工作将节点守界有限元方法扩展到线性输运方程。作为基线离散化，我们使用最小二乘有限元方法，这有助于实现二阶时间步进的无条件稳定性。它还导致了对称代数系统，从而实现了简单、高效的求解器，我们通过安德森加速进一步增强了这一点。证明了向后的欧拉和克兰克-尼科尔森离散化的无条件稳定性。我们还推导了完全离散二阶方案的误差估计，并提供了各种数值示例，包括两相不可压缩流。

item.title: Meshless Latent Dynamics Models for Model Order Reduction of time-dependent Partial Differential Equations
item.description: Latent dynamics learning has emerged as a prominent approach for Model Order Reduction (MOR) of time-dependent, parameterized Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). Traditional autoencoder-based approaches are intrinsically tied to fixed spatial discretizations during both training and inference, motivating the development of meshless methodologies. In this context, conditioning provides a natural mechanism for representing temporal evolution through spatially continuous functions, enabling mesh-agnostic Latent Dynamics Models (LDMs). In this work, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for mesh-agnostic LDMs based on conditioning in Neural Fields (NeFs). Leveraging a taxonomy of conditioning mechanisms (weak, strong, and pure), we formulate meshless LDMs as NeFs conditioned on a latent state. We establish a Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) for this class of models and analyze their stability by deriving Lipschitz bounds for different conditioning mechanisms. Our analysis reveals an expressivity--stability trade-off, providing insight into why more expressive conditioning, despite its higher representational capacity, can

item.title: 用于高频亥姆霍兹问题的基于鲁棒边缘多尺度空间的混合施瓦茨预处理器
item.description: We develop a novel hybrid Schwarz method, termed the robust edge multiscale space based hybrid Schwarz method (REMs-HS), for the efficient solution of high-frequency Helmholtz problems. The method combines a one-level restricted additive Schwarz preconditioner with impedance transmission conditions (RAS-imp) and an edge multiscale (EMs) coarse solver in a multiplicative way. A key ingredient of our construction is a modified impedance boundary condition (mIBC), which is imposed both on the subdomain problems and on the local problems that generate the EMs coarse space. Compared with the original impedance boundary condition, the mIBC makes the proposed method both stable and inexpensive theoretically. We prove that the resulting REMs-HS preconditioner gives rise to a uniform convergent fixed-point iteration for large wavenumbers. Moreover, the required resolution conditions are substantially relaxed. Only a mild condition on the level parameter $\ell$ of the hierarchical coarse basis $\ell>\frac{1}{2}\log_2 k$ is needed, which is markedly weaker than the conditions in previous analyses. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the

item.title: A Good-Vorticity Low-Regularity Integrator for the Inviscid Oldroyd--B System with Stress Diffusion
item.description: 我们为环面应力扩散的二维无粘 Oldroyd--B 系统的顺序半隐式好涡度积分器建立了锐收敛结果。对于满足 $u\in C_tB^{1+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$ 和 $\tau\in C_tB^\alpha_{\infty,1}\cap L^1_tB^{2+\alpha}_{\infty,1}$、$0\le\alpha\le2$ 的精确解，我们证明了临界范数 $B^1_{\infty,1}\times 的收敛性B^0_{\infty,1}$，在这些正则性假设成立的每个有限区间上的时间节点上均匀分布，包括关键端点 $\alpha=0$。对于 $0<\alpha\le2$，我们获得速率 $O(h^{\alpha/2})$，无需任何额外的时间 H\"较早的假设，在 $\alpha=2$ 处达到一阶。这些代数指数对于所述欧拉方案在所述解类上是最优的，如具有非零速度平均值的情况 $a=b=0$ 的固定数据下界所示。对于临界正则的固定剪切解，我们建立匹配的对数上限和下限数值误差的界限，排除每个正代数收敛率我们还证明了时间节点处的一个应力导数的增益是最优的。

item.title: A well-balanced path-conservative discontinuous Galerkin method with generalized hydrostatic reconstruction for non-conservative balance laws
item.description: 我们提出了一种用于具有非保守乘积的一维平衡律的高阶良好平衡路径保守不连续伽辽金方法。单元界面处的广义流体静力重建将有效数值通量与 Dal Maso-LeFloch-Murat 路径积分耦合起来，而单元参考平衡分解则消除了体积离散化中由投影引起的残差。在平衡恢复、容许性、路径和边界数据的明确假设下，空间离散是路径保守的，并且半离散格式及其全离散 SSP-RK 近似精确地保留了规定的静止和移动平衡。该框架应用于两层浅水方程和具有空间变化血管特性的血流模型。数值实验证实了设计的精度顺序以及平滑和不连续平衡的舍入水平保持，证明了小扰动的精确分辨率，并表明界面处理捕获了冲击和固定材料接触，而没有可见的寄生振荡。

item.title: Numerical methods for nonlinear stochastic differential equations driven by subdiffusion
item.description: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) driven by subdiffusion see great applications in anomalous transport and asset price dynamics. Trusted numerical methods are essential for their application in practice. In this paper, for SDEs driven by subdiffusion with superlinear coefficients, we propose a brand-new explicit numerical method. The sharp convergence rate is proved with new techniques. The potential application of the proposed method in numerically solving a generalized Fokker-Planck equation is also illustrated. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the theoretical results.

item.title: An Efficient Randomized Hierarchical Tucker Decomposition
item.description: We introduce randomized algorithms for computing the hierarchical Tucker decomposition of high-order tensors. Unlike traditional algorithms performed in a sequential leaves-to-root direction, our algorithms traverse the dimension tree in a root-to-leaves direction, leveraging randomized sequential projections to accelerate the computation of intermediate subspaces. This strategy can reduce the computation time by an order of magnitude relative to prior randomized algorithms using the leaves-to-root direction, while guaranteeing quasi-optimal approximation. Although the theoretical error bound is slightly larger than for leaves-to-root methods, in all our experiments the practical error adheres to the classic bound. Our results highlight the method's potential for scalable tensor decompositions in high-dimensional data analysis.

item.title: The complexity of tilting
item.description: 代数中的许多显式构造在经典有限逻辑中不是一阶可定义的，但在无限逻辑中是可定义的。本文的目的是展示如何使用无限逻辑将算术中的模型理论结果提升为量词敏感的形式。我们将这个想法应用到 Jahnke 和 Kartas 关于完美类场模型理论的深刻结果中。我们的主要结果是，当且仅当某个句子 $\phi^{\natural}$ 在 $k$ 的非主超幂中成立时，一阶句子 $\phi$ 在完美域 $k$ 的倾斜 $k^{\flat}$ 中成立，其中 $\phi^{\natural}$ 不依赖于 $k$，并且仅比 $\phi$ 本身稍微复杂一些。特别是，倾斜在精确意义上保留了 L'evy 层次结构。为此，我们证明常量 $t$ 下的赋值字段的标准分解可以通过等级最多为 1 的公式无限地解释。

item.title: 强稳定场
item.description: Let $K$ be a field which is strongly stable, that is, stable and strongly dependent. Then $K$ is finite or algebraically closed. This answers a question of Shelah.

item.title: Loose Inductive Set Theories
item.description: We prove that KP, with Full Set Induction, is neither solid nor tight. More generally, every consistent theory obtained from KPC by adding a quantifier bounded set of sentences has a model with a parameter-free definable class surjection from its natural numbers onto its universe. Using such enumerations to define generic extensions by relative interpretations, we show that theories with the stable definable ground property are not tight. Ground definability over MOST and continuum coding over ZFC^{\Pi_3} yield applications to weak inductive set theories with large cardinals and forcing axioms. Finally, solidity for quantifier bounded extensions of MOST with Full Set Induction implies a Ground Axiom formulated using a fixed finite level of genericity; under the same solidity hypothesis, the corresponding extension of full ZFC proves the ordinary Ground Axiom.

item.title: A conjecture on Galois groups and large fields
item.description: 令 $p$ 为素数，并令 $K$ 为一个域，使得 $p$ 与绝对伽罗瓦群 $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$ 互质，从某种意义上说，$p$ 不能整除 $K$ 的任何有限伽罗瓦扩张的次数。我们推测 $K$ 在 Pop 意义上是大的：任何在 $K$ 上且具有 $K$ 有理点的平滑代数曲线 $C$ 都有无限多个 $K$ 有理点。这个猜想会对数理逻辑产生一些影响。例如，这意味着对具有积极特征的稳定领域的预期分类。我们为这个猜想提供了一些微弱的证据。具体来说，假设 $K$ 是完美域，并且 $\operatorname{Gal}(K)$ 与 $p$ 互质。那么$K$ 上的每个阿贝尔簇 $A$ 都具有 Zariski 稠密 $K$ 有理点，并且如果 $C$ 是一条小于 $7-p$ 的平滑曲线且至少有一个 $K$ 有理点，则 $C$ 具有无穷多个 $K$ 有理点。

item.title: Scott spectral gaps for trees are bounded
item.description: Given a Borel class of trees, we show that there is a tree in that class whose Scott sentence is not too much more complicated than the definition of the class. In particular, if the class is definable by a $\Pi_\alpha$ sentence, then there is a model of Scott rank at most $\alpha + 2$. This gives another proof-and one that does not require first proving Vaught's conjecture for trees-of the fact that trees are not faithfully Borel complete.

item.title: On Star operation and some ideals on the Baire space
item.description: 我们研究了贝尔空间 $\omega^\omega$ $(\mathbb{Z}^\omega)$ 上的几个 $\sigma$-理想，引入并研究了理想 $\mathcal{G}$ 和 $\mathcal{SMZ}^+$，以及贫集、强测度零集、最终不同理想和无限相等理想的经典理想，我们在这些理想之间建立了结构关系和适当的包含。我们还计算了 $\mathcal{M}_-$ 的基数不变量，证明它们与 $\sigma$-理想贫集的不变量相同。我们进一步分析集合族上的运算 $^*$，建立对偶关系，例如 $\mathcal{ED}^* = \mathcal{IE}$、$\mathcal{IE}^*=\mathcal{ED}$、$\mathcal{M}_-^*=\mathcal{SMZ}^+$ 和 $\mathcal{H}^* = \mathcal{G}$，并推导附加条件下理想值之间的分离集合论假设。最后，我们证明了理想 $\mathcal{M}_-$ 的树二分定理，并研究了相关的强迫概念。
